# Phase 1 Audit — Foundation

**Repository:** `D:\my vr lab`
**Audit date:** 2026-10-31
**Scope:** Auth, environment, offline persistence, RLS, user populations, simulation architecture, admin surface, bundle, tests.
**Status:** Phase 1 only. No application source, SQL migration, or configuration was changed. `PHASE1_AUDIT.md` is the only source artifact produced. `dist/` was regenerated by the required build command.

---

## Executive summary

1. **The foundation exists.** The repo contains one Supabase migration (`supabase/migrations/20261031000000_novalab_backend.sql`, 39,587 bytes), two Flutterwave Edge Functions, the React app, service layer, experiment catalog, and one dedicated simulation component. Phase 1 can proceed.
2. **Auth is already server-side when Supabase is configured.** `authenticateUser()` calls `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()` and roles come from `profiles.role`, not `user_metadata.role`. However, there is an offline/demo fallback that performs client-side password comparison and hardcodes `student@example.com`, `teacher@example.com`, `admin@example.com` with password `password`.
3. **The demo fallback is live in the production env file.** `.env.production` sets `VITE_ENABLE_OFFLINE_MODE=true` and uses placeholder Supabase values. `isSupabaseConfigured` rejects those placeholders, so a production build can fall back to client-side demo auth. This is a release blocker and must be fixed in Phase 2.
4. **Auth sessions are in `sessionStorage`, not httpOnly cookies.** Supabase is configured with a `sessionStorage` adapter, and `useAuth` caches the full user object under `novalab:user` in `sessionStorage`. There is no refresh timer, no `onAuthStateChange` subscription, no cross-tab sync, and no `isSubmitting` guard.
5. **The offline layer is localStorage-only.** There is no IndexedDB, no service worker, no PWA manifest, no sync queue, no sync engine, no online/offline status, and no retry/conflict handling. Progress, teacher workspace, subscriptions, and demo users are stored locally. A typed Supabase service layer exists but is not used by the dashboards for progress.
6. **RLS is enabled on all 11 current tables, with 33 policies.** All 11 tables have `enable row level security`. There are no pgTAP tests, no `supabase/tests/` directory, no `audit_log`, no `guardian_consents`, and no attempt/sync tables. Several policies are broader than the future three-population model.
7. **There are four roles, not three populations.** `profiles.role` is constrained to `student`, `teacher`, `admin`, `partner`. There is no `user_type`, no `admin_level`, no solo student, no solo teacher, and no guardian consent. Self-registration always creates a student. `partner` has no reachable dashboard.
8. **Simulation coverage is one dedicated simulation plus one shared apparatus bench.** `DNAExtractionPage` has a static Canvas 2D visual with four hardcoded steps, while the catalog defines three steps. The other 32 catalog experiments all route through `ExperimentPage`, whose only “interaction” is a click-only apparatus bench plus typed evidence. No simulation implements `SimulationDefinition`.
9. **The admin surface is presentational only.** `AdminDashboard` is rendered at `/dashboard` for admins and contains hardcoded mock statistics. There is no `/admin` route, no admin tabs, no admin CRUD, no audit log, and no school/support/super level distinction.
10. **Bundle and test gates are not met.** Initial JS is **929.12 kB raw / 254.23 kB gzip**, exceeding the <250 kB gzip budget by 4.23 kB. Tests pass (2 files, 9 tests) but there is no `test` script, no coverage provider, no jsdom/testing-library, no E2E, no contract tests, no RLS tests. `npm run lint` fails because no ESLint config exists.

## 1. Current auth flow

### Email/password login

- Entry point: `src/pages/LoginPage.tsx` → `useAuth().login()` → `authenticateUser()` in `src/services/authService.ts`.
- When Supabase is configured, `authenticateUser()` calls `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()` (`authService.ts:296-311`).
- The app user is loaded by `loadSupabaseUser()` which fetches `profiles` by `authUser.id` and maps `profile.role` (`authService.ts:174-188`).
- The session is managed by `supabase-js`; `src/lib/supabase.ts:4-15` configures a `sessionStorage` storage adapter with `persistSession: true`, `autoRefreshToken: true`, `detectSessionInUrl: true`.
- `useAuth` restores the session with `supabase.auth.getSession()` under an 8-second timeout (`useAuth.tsx:36-53`, `69-100`).
- The hydrated user object is cached as JSON under `sessionStorage['novalab:user']` (`useAuth.tsx:13`, `79`, `86`, `111`, `131`).
- `logout()` clears local state, removes the cache, and awaits `supabase.auth.signOut()` (`useAuth.tsx:138-150`). It is async.

### Offline/demo login

- `offlineAuthEnabled = !hasSupabaseConfig && env.VITE_ENABLE_OFFLINE_MODE` (`authService.ts:64`).
- Hardcoded demo accounts are in `authService.ts:66-70`:
  - `student@example.com` / `password`
  - `teacher@example.com` / `password`
  - `admin@example.com` / `password`
- These credentials are also displayed in the UI at `src/pages/LoginPage.tsx:187-190`.
- Offline passwords are SHA-256 hashes of `${email}:${password}`, compared client-side (`authService.ts:88-94`, `322-325`).
- The demo accounts are compared in plaintext (`authService.ts:339`).

### Token and cache locations

| Item | Storage | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Supabase access/refresh session | `sessionStorage` via custom adapter | `src/lib/supabase.ts:4-15` |
| Cached app user | `sessionStorage['novalab:user']` | `src/hooks/useAuth.tsx:13`, `29-30` |
| Offline demo users | `sessionStorage['novalab:mock-users']` | `src/services/authService.ts:8`, `55-61` |
| Progress | `localStorage` | `src/services/progressService.ts:1`, `40`, `55` |
| Teacher workspace | `localStorage['virtual-science-lab-teacher-workspaces']` | `src/services/teacherWorkspaceService.ts:3`, `42`, `57` |
| Subscriptions | `localStorage['virtual-science-lab-subscriptions']` | `src/services/subscriptionService.ts:4`, `31-35` |

### Role source

- `user_metadata.role` is **not read anywhere** in `src` or `supabase`.
- Role is read from `profiles.role` (`authService.ts:174-188`) and used by `app_role()` / `is_admin()` in the migration.
- `registerUser()` accepts a `role` parameter, but the Supabase path ignores it (`authService.ts:190-229`). The DB trigger `handle_new_user()` always inserts `role = 'student'` (`migration:297-322`).
- The offline path narrows supplied roles to `teacher` or `student`, so a caller can self-create an offline teacher account (`authService.ts:246-254`).

### Auth gaps / risks

- **Critical:** production offline fallback plus hardcoded demo admin (see `.env.production`, `authService.ts:64-70`, `LoginPage.tsx:187-190`).
- No `refreshSession()` timer firing 5 minutes before expiry.
- No `supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange()` subscription; multi-tab updates are not synchronized.
- No `isSubmitting` guard; double-submit is possible in `LoginPage`/`RegisterPage`.
- Session tokens are in `sessionStorage`, not httpOnly cookies. The spec’s target is not met.
- `logout()` clears the UI before `signOut()` resolves; if `signOut()` fails, the local cache is already gone but the server session may persist.
- No production guard against offline auth when Supabase is unconfigured.
- The cached user object can be stale until a fresh profile fetch or reload.

## 2. Current offline layer

### What exists

| Service | Storage | Key / shape | Read by | Write trigger |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `progressService.ts` | `localStorage` | `novalab_progress_<experimentKey>_<userId|guest>`, one JSON entry per experiment | `StudentDashboard`, `TeacherDashboard`, `SubjectLabPage`, experiment pages | Every step/score/practical change |
| `teacherWorkspaceService.ts` | `localStorage` | `virtual-science-lab-teacher-workspaces`, nested object keyed by teacher ID | `TeacherDashboard`; `StudentDashboard` reads the raw key directly | Video/question/lecture/answer mutations |
| `subscriptionService.ts` | `localStorage` | `virtual-science-lab-subscriptions`, keyed by user ID | Pricing/checkout fallback | Payment initiation/activation |
| `authService.ts` | `sessionStorage` | `novalab:mock-users`, demo/local users | Offline auth only | Offline registration |
| `useAuth.tsx` | `sessionStorage` | `novalab:user`, hydrated user cache | Session restore fallback | Login/register/restore |

### What does not exist

- No `src/lib/db.ts`.
- No IndexedDB usage; `idb` is not installed.
- No `attemptService.ts`, `attempts`, or `attemptEvents`.
- No `syncQueue`, `syncEngine`, or sync status store/component.
- No service worker, Workbox, `vite-plugin-pwa`, or web manifest.
- No `navigator.onLine` handling, `online`/`offline` listeners, `visibilitychange` flush, or retry timers.
- No `guardianConsentService`.
- No legacy migration module or `novalab:migrated-v3` marker.
- `OfflineQueue` exists only as an unused type in `src/types/index.ts:110-120`.
- No PWA install prompt.

### Important behavior

- `StudentDashboard` reads progress synchronously from `localStorage` (`StudentDashboard.tsx:16`).
- `TeacherDashboard` lists **all** progress records on the browser, not just students in the teacher’s classes (`TeacherDashboard.tsx:39-42`). It has no server scoping because it never calls `backendService`.
- `StudentDashboard` directly reads `localStorage['virtual-science-lab-teacher-workspaces']` to discover teacher IDs (`StudentDashboard.tsx:42`). This is a cross-service storage leak.
- `backendService.ts` contains Supabase CRUD for profiles, classes, assignments, progress, videos, questions, lectures, and analytics, but the dashboards and experiment pages do not use it for progress. The current UI is local-only.
- `src/index.html` explicitly unregisters any service worker and deletes caches (`index.html:8-20`). That is the opposite of the target PWA behavior.
- README is honest about this: “Service workers and IndexedDB-backed queues are still on the roadmap; the current offline layer uses `localStorage`” (`README.md:403`).

### Risk

- Clearing site data loses all progress, teacher workspace, and local subscriptions.
- The same browser shares teacher/student state through global keys; there is no per-device or per-account isolation for teacher analytics.
- No durability, no queue, no conflict handling, no visible sync state.

## 3. Current RLS coverage

### Tables and RLS state

All 11 current tables have RLS enabled (`migration:813-823`):

| # | Table | RLS enabled | Policy count |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `public.schools` | Yes | 2 |
| 2 | `public.profiles` | Yes | 4 |
| 3 | `public.subscriptions` | Yes | 2 |
| 4 | `public.classes` | Yes | 4 |
| 5 | `public.class_members` | Yes | 3 |
| 6 | `public.assignments` | Yes | 2 |
| 7 | `public.assignment_submissions` | Yes | 4 |
| 8 | `public.student_progress` | Yes | 4 |
| 9 | `public.teacher_videos` | Yes | 2 |
| 10 | `public.student_questions` | Yes | 4 |
| 11 | `public.online_lectures` | Yes | 2 |

**Total: 11 tables, 33 policies.** No current table is missing RLS.

### Policies verified in the migration

Full exact predicates are in Appendix A. Summary:

- `schools`: members can view own school; admins manage all.
- `profiles`: self/staff/admin view; admins insert; self or admin update; admins delete.
- `subscriptions`: owner/school/admin view; admins manage.
- `classes`: teacher/member/school staff/admin view; teachers create; teacher/admin update/delete.
- `class_members`: student/teacher/admin view; teacher/admin add; teacher/student/admin remove.
- `assignments`: class participants/admin view; teachers/admin manage.
- `assignment_submissions`: student/teacher/admin view; enrolled student insert; student/teacher/admin update; student/admin delete.
- `student_progress`: student/teacher/admin view; student/admin insert; student/teacher/admin update; student/admin delete.
- `teacher_videos`: any authenticated user can view; owner/admin manage.
- `student_questions`: student/teacher/admin view; student/admin ask; teacher/admin answer; teacher/admin delete.
- `online_lectures`: class participants or any authenticated user when `class_id` is null; teacher/admin manage.

### Server-side authorization helpers

All are `security definer` with `set search_path = public`:

- `app_role()` reads `profiles.role` for `auth.uid()` (`migration:204-212`).
- `app_school_id()` reads `profiles.school_id` (`migration:214-222`).
- `is_admin()` checks `role = 'admin'` only (`migration:224-235`).
- `teaches_class()`, `is_enrolled()`, `teacher_of_student()`, `is_teacher_of_assignment()` implement scoped checks.
- `protect_profile_fields()` prevents a non-admin self-update from changing `role`, `school_id`, and subscription fields (`migration:343-365`). It does **not** protect future `user_type` or `admin_level` columns because they do not exist yet.

### RLS gaps / risks

- No pgTAP tests and no `supabase/tests/` directory. RLS is unverified by automated tests.
- No `audit_log` table.
- No `guardian_consents` table.
- No attempt/event/sync tables on the server.
- No `user_type` or `admin_level` columns; `is_admin()` is binary.
- `teacher_videos` view policy allows every authenticated user to read every teacher’s videos across all schools (`migration:1030-1040`).
- `online_lectures` with `class_id IS NULL` is visible to every authenticated user (`migration:1068-1076`). Cross-school leak risk.
- `classes` insert allows a teacher/admin to set any `school_id`, including a school they do not belong to (`migration:898-904`).
- `profiles` self-update plus trigger protects current sensitive columns, but future columns must be added to the trigger.
- No policy tests prove “solo cannot read school”, “school cannot read solo”, “support read-only”, “super full”. Those populations do not exist yet.
- `partner` is in RLS role checks but has no frontend dashboard and is blocked by `/dashboard`.

## 4. Current user population model

### Stored roles

`profiles.role` is constrained to:

```sql
role text not null default 'student'
  check (role in ('student', 'teacher', 'admin', 'partner'))
```

(`migration:28-43`)

TypeScript mirrors this in `src/types/index.ts:4`:

```ts
export type UserRole = 'student' | 'teacher' | 'admin' | 'partner';
```

### Current behavior by role

| Role | Can sign in | Dashboard | Labs/experiments | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `student` | Yes, self-registration | `/dashboard` → `StudentDashboard` | Yes | Default for all Supabase signups |
| `teacher` | Only if provisioned externally | `/dashboard` → `TeacherDashboard` | No | No teacher signup route; teacher nav targets `/dashboard` |
| `admin` | Only if provisioned externally | `/dashboard` → `AdminDashboard` | No | Static page; no `/admin` routes |
| `partner` | Yes if provisioned | None | No | Excluded from `/dashboard` guard; no reachable authenticated page |

### Signup

- `/register` (`src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx`) always calls `register(..., 'student')` at line 40.
- Supabase signup sends only `name` in metadata (`authService.ts:201-209`).
- The `handle_new_user()` trigger inserts `role = 'student'` (`migration:297-322`).
- There is no school selection, school code, age band, guardian phone, or subscription tier selection.
- Teacher and admin accounts are created outside the app; no admin user-creation UI exists.

### What `profiles.role` is set to in production

**Not verifiable from the repository.** There is no production data snapshot, seed for profiles, or admin provisioning script. The code guarantees that self-registered users are `student`; teacher/admin rows must have been created manually or by an out-of-repo process. No demo users are seeded into Supabase (`supabase/seed.sql` only inserts one school).

### Missing populations

- No `user_type` (`school_student`, `solo_student`, `solo_teacher`, etc.).
- No `admin_level` (`school`, `support`, `platform`/super).
- No nullable/`NOT NULL` constraints distinguishing school vs solo users.
- No guardian consent model.
- No solo student or solo teacher dashboards/routes.
- No subscription tier/status modelling distinct from the current `subscriptions` table and profile subscription fields.

## 5. Current simulation architecture

### What exists

| Surface | File | Route | Interaction model | Persistence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DNA Extraction page | `src/pages/experiments/DNAExtractionPage.tsx` | `/experiments/dna-extraction` | Four hardcoded steps; “Next” always passes `true`; click-only; typed data cards are uncontrolled; “Submit Results” has no handler | Progress in `localStorage` only; simulation state is just `currentStep` |
| DNA canvas | `src/components/simulations/DNAExtractionSimulation.tsx` | embedded | Static Canvas 2D redrawn per step; no pointer, keyboard, drag, or scoring | None; `onStepChange` is passed but unused |
| Generic experiment page | `src/pages/experiments/ExperimentPage.tsx` | `/experiments/:slug` (32 slugs) | Three catalog steps; “Next” advances without validation; final “Finish” requires bench evidence; click-only bench + typed measurement/observation | Progress in `localStorage` only |
| Apparatus bench | `src/components/apparatus/ApparatusSection.tsx` | embedded | Select apparatus → place on bench → use → run trial → type measurement + observation → submit; native buttons/inputs; `aria-pressed` on selected apparatus | React state only; resets on reload; completion callback writes one boolean to page progress |
| Dead bench | `src/components/simulations/InteractiveExperimentBench.tsx` | none | Similar click/type bench; hardcoded subject apparatus; **not imported anywhere** | None |
| Demo | `src/components/demo/DemoStage.tsx`, `LabScene.tsx` | `/demo` via `DemoPage` | Scripted animated demo with timer, audio, score ring; not an experiment route | Component state only |

### DNA Extraction specifics

- Catalog source of truth: `src/data/experimentCatalog.ts` has **3 steps** for `dna-extraction`: “Prepare the Sample”, “Separate the DNA”, “Record and Conclude”.
- Page hardcodes **4 different steps** (`DNAExtractionPage.tsx:19-60`): “Setup Equipment”, “Prepare Sample”, “Extract DNA”, “Collect & Observe”.
- Scoring is `Math.round(((stepIndex + 1) / steps.length) * 100)` (`DNAExtractionPage.tsx:62-72`). The only call passes `isCorrect = true` (`line 196`), so there is no wrong-path scoring.
- Final “Finish” is blocked until `practicalComplete` is true, which is set by submitting any non-empty measurement and observation in the shared bench.
- The canvas only draws static diagrams per step (`DNAExtractionSimulation.tsx:11-46`, canvas `48-56`). It has no `role`, `aria-label`, `tabIndex`, keyboard handler, pointer handler, or animation loop.
- Data cards are uncontrolled and unconnected to state (`DNAExtractionPage.tsx:271-277`, `DataInputCard` at `283-300`). “Submit Results” (`line 277`) has no `onClick`.
- Progress is read/written with `getProgress`/`setProgress` for key `dna-extraction` (`lines 87`, `95`, `108`).

### Generic experiment specifics

- All remaining catalog entries render through `ExperimentPage` (`src/App.tsx:139-149`).
- `handleAdvance()` advances steps without validating apparatus use (`ExperimentPage.tsx:76-85`).
- On the final step, if `practicalComplete` is true, `setScore(100)` runs unconditionally (`ExperimentPage.tsx:88`). There are no partial scores, no per-step points, no penalties, and no rubric.
- The shared bench derives apparatus from `apparatusCatalog.ts` by slug and offers a generic reading (`ApparatusSection.tsx:31`).
- Evidence requires typed `measurement` and `observation` text (`ApparatusSection.tsx:51`, `297-316`). This is not keyboard-only completion because typing is mandatory.

### Catalog inventory

- **33 experiments** in `src/data/experimentCatalog.ts`.
- Every experiment has exactly **3 steps**.
- Subject/level split: biology 11 (9 O-level, 2 A-level), chemistry 10 (7 O, 3 A), physics 8 (6 O, 2 A), agriculture 4 O-level.
- Apparatus counts per experiment range from 7 to 15; full inventory in Appendix B.
- No catalog entry references a simulation ID/version, `SimulationDefinition`, rubric, hints, or device tier.
- `src/types/index.ts` has an `Experiment` interface with `simulationComponent` and `dataFields`, but `src/data/experimentCatalog.ts` uses its own `ExperimentEntry` shape and does not use that interface.

### Accessibility / input

- DNA canvas: inaccessible to screen readers and keyboard users; no live region; no text alternative.
- Generic bench: native buttons/inputs and illustration SVGs with `role="img"`/`aria-label` (`ApparatusIllustration.tsx:1508-1519`), but no `aria-live` feedback, no hint system, no keyboard-completable evidence path (typing required), and no visible focus ring on some inputs (`ApparatusSection.tsx:297-316`).
- No `prefers-reduced-motion` handling anywhere.
- No test proves keyboard or touch completion.

### Bundle contribution

There are no per-simulation chunks. All simulation code is inside the single main chunk. Source-level gzip proxies (not build chunks):

| File | Raw bytes | Source gzip proxy |
|---|---:|---:|
| `DNAExtractionSimulation.tsx` | 10,813 | 2,333 |
| `InteractiveExperimentBench.tsx` | 7,844 | 2,528 |
| `ApparatusSection.tsx` | 18,220 | 4,578 |
| `ApparatusIllustration.tsx` | 93,123 | 17,350 |
| `DemoStage.tsx` | 48,697 | 11,123 |
| `LabScene.tsx` | 16,238 | 4,045 |
| `apparatusCatalog.ts` | 108,510 | 28,822 |
| `experimentCatalog.ts` | 58,691 | 14,672 |

### Dependencies

- React 18, TypeScript, `react-router-dom`, Tailwind.
- `useAuth`, `progressService`, `apparatusCatalog`, `ApparatusIllustration`, `LabAIGuide`, `SubjectIcon`.
- `p5` and `three` are installed but **not imported anywhere in `src`**. They are tree-shaken out of the current build. No simulation uses WebGL/Three.js.

### Adaptation flags

- **DNA Extraction:** cannot be adapted as-is; the contract needs a rewrite of the interaction model and state, not a wrapper. Estimated 2–3 days including keyboard/pointer paths, rubric, hints, persistence, tests, and a11y.
- **ApparatusSection:** can be wrapped as a shared “apparatus familiarisation” adapter, but it is not a real per-experiment simulation. Estimated 1–2 days to wrap; each experiment still needs its own domain logic.
- **InteractiveExperimentBench:** dead code. Recommend deleting after approval, or 0.5 day to wrap if kept.
- **DemoStage/LabScene:** demo-only, outside experiment routes; not a contract candidate. 0 effort for Phase 7/8; 2–3 days if converted to a real simulation later.
- **32 generic experiments:** no dedicated simulation logic exists; each needs a new definition/simulation. Rough estimate: 0.5–1.5 days for simple apparatus/measurement experiments and 2–4 days for advanced ones. Total is large and should be sequenced after the DNA reference.

## 6. Current admin page

- Route: `/dashboard` only, guarded by `PrivateRoute` with `allowedRoles={['student', 'teacher', 'admin']}` (`src/App.tsx:60-81`).
- Admin branch: `user.role === 'admin'` renders `AdminDashboard` inside the normal `Layout`.
- There is **no** `/admin`, `/admin/schools`, `/admin/solo-students`, `/admin/solo-teachers`, `/admin/platform`, or `/admin/audit` route.
- There is no `AdminGuard`, `AdminLayout`, `src/pages/admin/` directory, or tab component.
- `AdminDashboard.tsx` is static. All figures (120 schools, 31.5K users, 156.8K experiments, 99.8% uptime, regional counts) are hardcoded. There are no `onClick` handlers beyond presentational buttons, no `useState`/`useEffect`, no Supabase calls, and no service calls.
- The “Manage Users”, “Manage Content”, “Manage Schools”, “View Logs”, “Maintenance”, and “Generate Reports” buttons do nothing.
- Layout admin links point to `#`; no routes are attached.
- There is no audit log table or admin mutation audit.
- There is no school/support/super admin level. `is_admin()` is the only check and grants full access.

## Gap list against the ship-ready standard

| Ship-ready requirement | Current status | Evidence / blocker | Target phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Offline-first with IndexedDB (not localStorage) | **Missing** | All persistence is localStorage/sessionStorage; no `idb`, no `db.ts` | Phase 3 |
| Service worker + installable PWA | **Missing** | No plugin/manifest/SW; `index.html` actively unregisters SWs | Phase 3 |
| Sync engine with visible status | **Missing** | No sync engine, queue, store, or status UI | Phase 3 |
| Auth in httpOnly cookies / managed sessions | **Partial / not met** | Supabase JWT in `sessionStorage`; no httpOnly cookie flow | Phase 2 |
| No client-side password comparison | **Met when Supabase configured; not met offline** | Offline path compares SHA-256 client-side | Phase 2 |
| No demo backdoor in production | **Not met** | `.env.production` enables offline mode; demo admin hardcoded and displayed | Phase 2 |
| Three user populations | **Missing** | Only `student/teacher/admin/partner`; no `user_type` | Phase 4 |

## Appendix A — RLS policy matrix

Source: `supabase/migrations/20261031000000_novalab_backend.sql:813-1085`.

| Table | Policy | Command | Predicate (USING / WITH CHECK) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schools` | `Schools: members can view own school` | SELECT | `id = app_school_id() OR is_admin()` |
| `schools` | `Schools: admins manage` | ALL | `is_admin()` / `is_admin()` |
| `profiles` | `Profiles: self or staff can view` | SELECT | `id = auth.uid() OR is_admin() OR teacher_of_student(id) OR (school_id IS NOT NULL AND school_id = app_school_id() AND app_role() IN ('teacher','admin','partner'))` |
| `profiles` | `Profiles: admins insert` | INSERT | `is_admin()` |
| `profiles` | `Profiles: update self` | UPDATE | `id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` / same |
| `profiles` | `Profiles: admins delete` | DELETE | `is_admin()` |
| `subscriptions` | `Subscriptions: owner or admin can view` | SELECT | `user_id = auth.uid() OR school_id = app_school_id() OR is_admin()` |
| `subscriptions` | `Subscriptions: admins manage` | ALL | `is_admin()` / `is_admin()` |
| `classes` | `Classes: teacher, member, school staff, admin can view` | SELECT | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_enrolled(id) OR is_admin() OR (school_id = app_school_id() AND app_role() IN ('teacher','admin','partner'))` |
| `classes` | `Classes: teachers create` | INSERT | `teacher_id = auth.uid() AND app_role() IN ('teacher','admin')` |
| `classes` | `Classes: teachers update own` | UPDATE | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` / same |
| `classes` | `Classes: teachers delete own` | DELETE | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `class_members` | `Class members: student, teacher, admin can view` | SELECT | `student_id = auth.uid() OR teaches_class(class_id) OR is_admin()` |
| `class_members` | `Class members: teachers add` | INSERT | `teaches_class(class_id) OR is_admin()` |
| `class_members` | `Class members: teachers or student remove` | DELETE | `teaches_class(class_id) OR student_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `assignments` | `Assignments: class participants can view` | SELECT | `teaches_class(class_id) OR is_enrolled(class_id) OR is_admin()` |
| `assignments` | `Assignments: teachers manage` | ALL | `teaches_class(class_id) OR is_admin()` / same |
| `assignment_submissions` | `Submissions: student or teacher can view` | SELECT | `student_id = auth.uid() OR is_teacher_of_assignment(assignment_id) OR is_admin()` |
| `assignment_submissions` | `Submissions: students insert own` | INSERT | `student_id = auth.uid() AND EXISTS (assignment joined to class_members for auth.uid())` |
| `assignment_submissions` | `Submissions: students or teachers update` | UPDATE | `student_id = auth.uid() OR is_teacher_of_assignment(assignment_id) OR is_admin()` / same |
| `assignment_submissions` | `Submissions: student or admin delete` | DELETE | `student_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `student_progress` | `Progress: student or teacher can view` | SELECT | `student_id = auth.uid() OR teacher_of_student(student_id) OR is_admin()` |
| `student_progress` | `Progress: students insert own` | INSERT | `student_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `student_progress` | `Progress: student or teacher update` | UPDATE | `student_id = auth.uid() OR teacher_of_student(student_id) OR is_admin()` / same |
| `student_progress` | `Progress: student or admin delete` | DELETE | `student_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `teacher_videos` | `Videos: authenticated users can view` | SELECT | `auth.uid() IS NOT NULL` |
| `teacher_videos` | `Videos: teachers manage own` | ALL | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` / same |
| `student_questions` | `Questions: student, teacher or admin can view` | SELECT | `student_id = auth.uid() OR teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `student_questions` | `Questions: students ask` | INSERT | `student_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `student_questions` | `Questions: teachers answer` | UPDATE | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` / same |
| `student_questions` | `Questions: teacher or admin delete` | DELETE | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` |
| `online_lectures` | `Lectures: participants can view` | SELECT | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin() OR (class_id IS NOT NULL AND is_enrolled(class_id)) OR (class_id IS NULL AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL)` |
| `online_lectures` | `Lectures: teachers manage own` | ALL | `teacher_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin()` / same |

All 11 tables are listed under `alter table ... enable row level security` at `migration:813-823`. No table is exempt.
